text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That day, the members were summoned. 
Currently, several dozen Umamusume are 
participating in Project L'Arc.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, only four can challenge the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe— To truly win, one 
must be prepared to select the Umamusume 
capable of victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The right to challenge the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe, which they must compete for 
amongst themselves— Yet, Mei Satake says 
that the members are both rivals and 
teammates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a dream stage for everyone, and 
that's precisely why the experience gained 
from clashing wholeheartedly with rivals 
becomes a ticket to the future.
